on_actions = {
    on_daily_SOV = {
        effect = {
            TPMP_SOV_check_four_year_plan = yes
        }
    }

    on_weekly_SOV = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_completed_focus = TPMP_SOV_expand_the_role_of_nkvd
                }
                add_to_variable = { TPMP_SOV_workers_var = 1375 }
            }
            TPMP_SOV_mon_weekly_pulse = yes # TPMP_SOV_mon hook
        }





    }

    # TPMP_SOV_mon hook: Monster (wall of heads) + Stalin's ears, generated by sovgen/monster
    on_monthly_SOV = {
        effect = {
            TPMP_SOV_mon_monthly_pulse = yes
        }
    }

    on_startup = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = SOV }
                SOV = { TPMP_SOV_mon_init = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
